name: Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Mega Kuningan
positioning: Ritz-Carlton hotel in Jakarta's Kuningan business district, officially The Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Mega Kuningan, with a spice-trade design theme
best_for: Travelers who want a base in the Kuningan business district
Guests who like hands-on local experiences such as making jamu

facts.text: The hotel is in the Kuningan business district, surrounded by corporate offices, embassies, shopping malls and residences.
Guests are welcomed on arrival with a glass of jamu, an ancient remedy of herbs and spices.
The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge overlooks the skyline of the Jakarta business district.
The Club Lounge offers five culinary offerings: breakfast, light lunch, afternoon tea, evening cocktails, and cordials and chocolates.
At Asia Restaurant, chefs prepare Pan-Asian and Western dishes in an open kitchen.
Lobo has an indoor and outdoor setting where global cuisines are served.
Asia Restaurant's weekend brunch buffet features seafood, a prime meats selection and fine cheeses.
Spa facilities include a steam room, sauna, cold plunge, soaking tub, and a private locker room with a lounge area.
The hotel has a fitness center, a spa and an outdoor pool.
The Ritz Kids program offers a carnival-themed in-room camp for children.

highlights.text: In the Spice Trail experience, guests make their own jamu, an Indonesian herbal tonic, with the hotel's jamu-making experts and take home a keepsake bottle.
The hotel's design is inspired by the ancient spice trade.
The spa sits amid tropical gardens and includes four spa villas with private outdoor soaking tubs.
Ozone is a sports bar with live game experiences and a Golfzon indoor golf simulator.

considerations.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.
WhataHotel notes the business district location may lack a cultural neighborhood atmosphere.
